$comment: Schema version 1.1 (WP-13, additive/backward-compatible over the WP-08 v1 shape): adds the optional `house_system` property and documents that `body` now also carries house-cusp point names (ASC, MC, CUSP_1..CUSP_12) alongside planet names. `body` was already an unrestricted string (no enum) in v1, so no existing validation rule changed — every entry that validated under v1 still validates unchanged here; this is a documentation-only widening plus one new optional field. See project/tools/ephemeris/produce-ledger.mjs's `--houses` flag (WP-13) for the producer, and project/src/core/variants.js's HOUSE_SYSTEMS registry for the canonical house_system id spellings (e.g. "placidus", "koch", "whole_sign" — snake_case, matched exactly).
title: HCRM Exact Ephemeris Ledger Entry

body.description: A planet/point name (e.g. "Sun", "Moon", ...) or, as of WP-13, a house-cusp point name: "ASC", "MC", or "CUSP_1".."CUSP_12". Deliberately left as an open string (no enum) rather than a closed list, consistent with v1 — this keeps the schema additive.

house_system.description: Optional (WP-13 addition). Present only on ASC/MC/CUSP_1..CUSP_12 entries produced by a specific quadrant house system; absent on planet entries and on entries without a computed house_system. Value is the house system's `id` string from project/src/core/variants.js's HOUSE_SYSTEMS registry (e.g. "placidus", "koch", "regiomontanus", "campanus", "alcabitius", "topocentric", "morinus", "meridian") — matched exactly, including its underscore/hyphen convention (this registry uses snake_case, e.g. "whole_sign", never "whole-sign"). Omitting this field is valid (backward compatible with every v1 entry, none of which have it).

meta.description: Optional producer diagnostics (WP-08 addition, additive/backward-compatible — entries without `meta` remain valid). Not consumed by validateLedgerEntry/admitForCore; carried for downstream tooling (accuracy/retrograde tests, later packages) that wants speed/timescale context without recomputing it.

jd_tt.description: Julian Day, Terrestrial Time, at the requested instant.

delta_t_seconds.description: TT - UT1 (approximated as TT - UTC) at the requested instant, seconds.

speed_arcsec_per_day.description: Signed decimal-integer string: ecliptic-longitude rate of change, rounded to the nearest arcsecond/day, via central difference (+/-6h).

retrograde.description: True iff the underlying (unrounded) speed is negative.
